summary: Bounded extraction: shared AppKit offscreen compositor (no NSView/window) owned once and used by editor + workflow; hoist duplicate FinalAction; move generic PNG/bitmap helpers out of ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic. Keep interactive canvas, text commit, and UI chrome in EditorCanvasView. Do not round-trip EditorCanvasState merely to render live items.
findings: Workflow currently builds a throwaway EditorCanvasView only for compositing: annotatedBaseImage → EditorCanvasView(image:canvasBase, initialState:state).compositeImage() (ScreenshotWorkflowController.swift:839-848). Same base-preference rule as editor init: state.baseImagePNG over pending/caller image (EditorWindowController.swift:142-156).

True compositing owner today is EditorCanvasView.renderCompositeImage + exportBounds (EditorCanvasView.swift:295-297, 828-893). Interactive draw(_:) adds edge chrome, selection outlines, and in-progress previews (386-458) that must NOT appear in export.

Pixel contract: bitmap pixels = floor/ceil crop points × baseImagePixelScale(); rep.size stays point size of crop; flipped context + Y-flip + translate(-cropOrigin); clear fill then base sourceOver then items. Comment at 840-844 documents prior Retina lockFocus doubling bug. Tests lock 100×80 native resolution and quadrant orientation.

Coords: flipped top-left; baseImageOrigin defaults to canvasEdgeInset 24; annotations are canvas-space; restore shifts items by (newOrigin − savedOrigin) when baseImageOrigin present (144-158). v1 nil origin = no shift. exportBounds = union(baseImageBounds, item bounds) then floor/ceil normalize (828-835, 663-668).

Erase: opaque black fill with .destinationOut (536-541). Order after prior layers is load-bearing. Text: compositeImage/endTextEditingIfNeeded commits live editor before render (295-297, 1542-1545); headless state render has no editor. Paste image items decode PNG once at state→Item (1850-1852); serialize uses pngData only for editableState, not for compose.

Duplicate enums: ScreenshotWorkflowController.FinalAction (14-19) ≡ EditorCanvasView.FinalActionCommand (28-34). EditorWindowController typealiases workflow FinalAction and case-maps FinalActionCommand 1:1 (36, 700-714); escape maps only closeOnly vs deleteOnly (61-62, 141).

Generic PNG/bitmap live in ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic.pngData/bitmapRepresentation (32-77) but are used by canvas state, workflow persistence/reopen, and capture save—not capture-specific. Capture-specific keepers: shouldSuppressCaptureFailureAlert, resizedImageIfNeeded, uniqueScreenshotURL, screenCaptureRect.

Over-extraction conflicts (broader than benefit): rewriting to pure Foundation/CG; extracting hit-testing/undo/text UI; encoding live Items→EditorCanvasState→decode solely to compose; sharing draw(_:) including chrome; merging note burn (WorkflowNoteRenderer) into compositor.
decisions: Proposed type: EditorCanvasCompositor (AppKit OK). API: compose(baseImage:baseImageOrigin:items:croppingTo:) mirroring renderCompositeImage; compose(state:fallbackBase:) for workflow after isSafeToRestore, decoding items once, applying same origin shift as canvas init, crop=exportBounds. Optional crop for selection export (renderSelectedRegionImage).

Share committed-item drawing + export geometry + arrow constants with the view; leave preview/chrome/text editor on the view. Runtime Item model (or package-visible twin) is the compose input—never Codable round-trip for live canvas compose.

FinalAction: single shared enum (small file or hoist from workflow); canvas KeyCommand.finalAction and window onComplete use it; delete FinalActionCommand. Escape still chooses .closeOnly vs .deleteOnly from escapeKeyDeletesFile.
PNG/bitmap: move to ImageBitmapConversion (name flexible) with thin ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic wrappers optional only if call-site churn must be staged; prefer direct call-site retarget.
Rejected: constructing NSView for headless compose; Foundation-only renderer; extracting full EditorCanvasView.

Whether ScreenshotServiceCoreLogic keeps deprecated forwarding wrappers during stage 1 is a parent/style call only.

Hypothesis (not re-verified by running tests): compose(state:) with items baked at inset 24 and nil baseImageOrigin must match current note-only pixel test; if state later always stores baseImageOrigin, shift math must stay identical to init.

Stage order: (1) extract PNG/bitmap helpers + retarget call sites; (2) extract EditorCanvasCompositor and wire EditorCanvasView.compositeImage/renderSelectedRegionImage through it with zero workflow change; (3) annotatedBaseImage → compositor (drop EditorCanvasView construction); (4) consolidate FinalAction; (5) run existing tests only—no new tests required this effort.

Minimal later regression gates: testCompositeImagePreservesNativeResolution; testCompositeImagePreservesOrientation; testEditableStateUsesCleanBaseInsteadOfPendingComposite; testNoteOnlySaveOnReopenedAnnotatedFileKeepsAnnotationPixels (+ prompt companion); ScreenshotServiceCoreLogicTests bitmap/png after move; spot-check erase transparency and annotation-beyond-base export growth if touching draw/export paths.
